reference_review: Author reviewed each criterion against reviewed015 and explicit source evidence before any generation. Not independently human-adjudicated. Further source-only independent review, if performed, must occur before freeze consumption.

families.delivery-verification-order: EN chat pair; correct consultation is preserved across the confidential-disclosure violation, including independent identity and management deductions.
families.delivery-answer-implication: RU chat pair; complete implicit answer versus real omission and explicit ignored complaint. This pair deliberately changes multiple relevant facts, not a single-variable experiment.
families.delivery-prerequisite-recovery: KZ call pair; correct progressive clarification versus premature dependent advice, followed by explicit correction and authoritative no-harm recovery. Both include genuinely unavailable private approval state with a valid investigation next step.
families.delivery-custom-checklist-change: Identical complete conversation under channel-only versus channel-and-deadline criterion. Must remain together and be reported separately from the official-rubric primary set.

excluded_before_generation.reason: Reviewed015 does not uniquely settle how to grade an incorrect key instruction explicitly withdrawn before use, with verified correct recovery and no established remaining consequence. Do not claim a definite ordinal winner. All source-grounded correction, residual-consequence and prerequisite findings remain mandatory.
excluded_before_generation.acceptable_behavior: Preserve the original error, later correction and verified Q/support submissions, distinguish submission from approval, and explain the temporal treatment. An ordinal selected with an explicit defensible interpretation or a specific needs_review decision is not exact-label credit.

semantic_checks.check: No false identity failure or confidentiality flag. Do not treat verification as missing customer-need information.
Preserve identity No, management7 and serious Yes while the accurate content answers retain consultation20. Later confirmation does not erase the earlier breach.
The explicit full-year dates and single-file instruction answer the annual possibility question without a standalone yes.

Annual export remains an open substantial request. m4 neutral reminder alone is not an empathy violation; m6 explicit ignored/lost-time complaint is. Do not invent a management defect merely from the content omission.

Acknowledge that private approval state is unavailable. The operator explicitly declines to assert approval and supplies the policy-approved investigation next step. Do not manufacture approval or require completed approval to credit that next step.

Preserve needs No and management7 after correction. Evidence of correct Q submission does not erase the premature country-specific answer. Original false R guidance, correction chronology and authoritative no-R-action log remain visible.
Same input produces Yes under version1 and No under version2; no hardcoded eight-criterion contract or prepared answer substitution.

predeclared_gate.primary_completion: All six complete as usable source-grounded assessments, including an explicit localized review if genuinely warranted; report numeric coverage separately.
predeclared_gate.exact_labels: All47 determinate primary status/answer pairs and both custom decisions must match for this small diagnostic gate. Report any disagreement; do not repair expectations after seeing outputs.
predeclared_gate.evidence: No invented citations, actor substitution, unsupported serious flag, missed explicit breach, erased legitimate deduction or fabricated private-state certainty. Review all full assessments.
predeclared_gate.repeats: If time/budget permits, repeat one case from each of the three primary families once with identical inputs/settings. Report all changed criteria and full-vector drift, including the excluded ordinal separately. Repeats are not new independent cases.
predeclared_gate.comparison: Run saved baseline and candidate on the same frozen source/checklist; report both first-pass and final bounded-repair outcomes. Do not retroactively count repairs as first-pass success.
predeclared_gate.score_error: Compute total-score MAE only on five complete primary reference vectors; count failures/provisional totals as missing coverage, not zero-error exclusions. Custom pair scores reported separately.
predeclared_gate.cost: Report every initial request and repair, including failed attempts, with tokens, cost and end-to-end latency.
predeclared_gate.promotion: A semantic high-impact failure blocks claiming success regardless of exact-label average. This six-case gate is necessary diagnostic evidence, not statistical proof of95–100 quality.

limitations: Six small fictional primary cases; only two voice-call transcripts, no audio or ASR stress.
Provisional AI-authored expectations, not organizer Ground Truth or independent expert accuracy.
No claim that this suite measures the true natural distribution or all domain facts.
One consultation ordinal excluded prospectively; never include its selected result in exact agreement or full-score MAE.
label_isolation: Model input is only case.conversation plus case.checklist_override or frozen reviewed015. Never include expectations, tags, family, this review, or acceptance outcomes. Model source IDs are synthetic identifiers, not answer keys.
pre_inference_source_id_revision: Before any generation, descriptive primary conversation IDs were replaced with delivery-source-001 through006; TestCase IDs remain outside model payload. Root confirmed no generation had started. No transcript, policy, expectation or criterion changed.
